movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Women wave, remove, and tip straw hats with ribbons; men play castanets
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Performed in pairs and various formations
movement_profile.posture: Men adopt a bent or stooped posture; women stand upright

signature_moves.description: Women tip their ribbon-adorned straw hats in salute to the Holy Cross
signature_moves.name: Hat Salute

music_profile.musical_form: Call-and-response chant followed by rhythmic percussion
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Constant beating of drums punctuated by wooden castanets
music_profile.sound_description: The music features a continuous, driving drum rhythm punctuated by sharp wooden castanet clicks, creating a lively, ritualistic atmosphere. Women’s chants narrate the discovery of the Holy Cross in metaphorical language.
music_profile.vocal_style: Chants sung by women in archaic, metaphorical language

basic_steps: Adopt a bent or stooped posture (men)
Perform in pairs with a partner
Women wave, remove, or tip straw hats with ribbons
Begin with a chant sung by women
Move rhythmically to drumbeats and castanet clacking
teaching.level_notes: Technique specifics such as footwork and counts are not described in sources
teaching.rhythm: Frenetic drumbeat with wooden castanet clacking
